seoDescription: See Gilbert Public Schools’ 2029–30 first and last days, fall, winter and spring breaks, early releases, half days, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2029–30 school year on Tuesday, July 24, 2029, and lists Thursday, May 23, 2030, as the last day for students. The family calendar includes 180 student days, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 conference half days, semester half days, and a June 3–28 summer school window.
calendarNotes: The 2029–30 GPS calendar continues the district’s multi-year planning format with 180 student days, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 conference half days, semester counts, and a summer school window.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Gilbert Public Schools start in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2029–30 school year on Tuesday, July 24, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Gilbert Public Schools spring break in 2030?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break runs from Monday, March 11, through Friday, March 22, 2030. Students return Monday, March 25.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Gilbert calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Gilbert Public Schools revisions.
